categories.main_business_segments: Sanhe Tongfei Refrigeration Co., Ltd. specializes in industrial temperature control equipment, offering four main product series: liquid constant temperature equipment, electrical box constant temperature devices, pure water cooling units, and special heat exchangers. These products serve diverse sectors including CNC equipment (machine tools, laser devices), power electronics (transmission, electrical drives), energy storage, semiconductor manufacturing, data centers, hydrogen energy, new energy vehicles (charging and swapping), medical devices, and industrial washing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced thermal engineering and control technologies, including high-precision temperature control (±0.1°C), use of high-purity water as cooling medium, and environmentally friendly refrigerants like R290 and R32. Production is order-driven, combining standardized and customized manufacturing, with partial outsourcing for components like sheet metal and wiring harnesses. R&D integrates technology and product development, collaborating with universities and customers to innovate and optimize manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading manufacturers in CNC machine tools, laser equipment, power electronics, energy storage systems, semiconductor fabrication equipment, data centers, hydrogen energy equipment, new energy vehicle charging infrastructure, medical imaging devices, and industrial washing machinery. The company maintains strong partnerships with prominent domestic and international firms such as CATL, Sunlight Power, North Huachuang, and United Imaging Healthcare.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with over 96% of revenue generated domestically. It also has an international presence through its wholly-owned German subsidiary, ATF Cooling GmbH, which facilitates access to European markets and international technology exchange. The company is expanding its global sales and service network to increase overseas market share.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sanhe Tongfei operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial temperature control supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sale of temperature control equipment and systems. It supplies critical components and integrated solutions to downstream equipment manufacturers across multiple high-tech industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-precision temperature control, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability. R&D efforts focus on developing advanced liquid cooling systems, environmentally friendly refrigerants, integrated laser thermal management, and intelligent temperature control systems with remote monitoring capabilities. It actively collaborates with academic institutions and participates in industry standard development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of industrial temperature control products and customized solutions. The company employs a direct sales model with a strong technical service component, providing pre-sale consulting, collaborative product design, and after-sale support to enhance customer value and retention.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sanhe Tongfei is positioned as a leading domestic industrial temperature control solutions provider with a broad product portfolio and strong market presence in key emerging industries. It competes with both domestic and international firms by leveraging its technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service capabilities. The company is recognized as a benchmark enterprise in China's industrial temperature control sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.16 billion, representing a 17.07% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 153.4 million, a decrease of 15.87% compared to the previous year. The company has steadily expanded its asset base to RMB 2.5 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures reaching nearly RMB 98.7 million, supporting sustained growth and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sanhe Tongfei emphasizes high precision, energy efficiency, and environmental compliance in its products, offering tailored temperature control solutions that enhance equipment reliability, safety, and lifespan. Its products feature advanced control systems, strong environmental adaptability, and integration capabilities, differentiating it as a comprehensive industrial temperature control expert. The company’s commitment to quality, innovation, and customer service underpins its competitive advantage.
